column3: Effective first-step energy and admissible microstructures are not specified in the literal record. Convexification gives a lower bound, but recovery sequences require the actual energy and quasiconvexity constraints; no full-scope certificate follows from this sentence.

A fixed finite lamination tree gives a computable upper bound, but equality with the rank-one convex envelope requires a global rank-one-convex lower support and attainment. Convex W is a vacuous sufficient subclass and does not resolve the intended finite-order criterion.
An analogue of Tian gauge needs the source deformation complex, pairing and gauge equivalence. Ordinary dg-Lie gauge fixing does not prove a vertex-algebra Tian lemma without these operators.

The existential forcing extension must preserve full Martin Maximum and create a parameter-free or real-parameter well-order of all H(omega_2). Coding a subset or adding a well-order externally does not establish internal definability while preserving the axiom.

The universal implication from Martin Maximum asks for an inner model with kappa-plus supercompactness, not just consistency strength or a finite large-cardinal fragment. No inner-model construction is supplied by a bounded certificate.

Exact ex(n,T5) for every n requires both extremal construction and universal upper bound including rounding and small exceptions. A multipartite construction or asymptotic density alone leaves the exact upper bound unresolved.

The literal record already asserts a theorem for all Dirac graphs with an asymptotic o(1). Counting permutations or applying Dirac existence gives no exponential-precision enumeration bound. Need the stated theorem's actual proof before treating this as an open target or public resolution.

The quantifiers cover every tree and every host order. Greedy embedding uses stronger minimum-degree assumptions; deleting low-degree vertices only yields an average-degree core and does not establish the required sharp tree embedding.

Non-isotropic steady states depend on both energy and angular momentum. A turning-point argument must connect a sequence's binding-energy maximum to a spectral/nonlinear instability criterion; differentiating the sequence does not control transverse perturbations.

Use the symbolic Kirillov matrix K: N=dim(g)-generic rank(K). If a maximal nonzero minor survives the contraction at t=0, ranks agree by semicontinuity. This finite determinant criterion directly instantiates the primary body's maximal-rank differential-form approach; no separate discovery brief.

An ordinary degree-zero Lie algebra has no higher degree 2-n operations on its unchanged graded vector space. The actual source discusses a resolution of divergence-free vector fields with higher operations. This category/underlying-complex distinction must be fixed before a purported rigid example is meaningful; no wording-fix result.

The pair (B,P) and compatibility/positivity/singularity assumptions are absent from the record. Gluing affine toric charts requires consistent wall data; an arbitrary pair cannot be addressed by an unconditional toric construction from this sentence.

The request is an optimal bound over rational reduced Hurwitz points. A finite morphism degree bounds some residue extension only after identifying the fiber and descent obstruction; it does not give optimality or handle all stabilizers and fields.

All projective component systems in a four-branch modular tower are quantified. Riemann-Hurwitz would convert known cusp-width and ramification growth into genus bounds, but controlling that growth uniformly through the tower is the missing input.

Every admissible partition must be realized by connected induced parts and the sufficient class must include nontraceable graphs. Primary body already lists tree/caterpillar results and an Ore-type sufficient theorem. A small nontraceable witness or reusing these classes does not establish another full class; no new criterion proved.

In the primary body's algebraic-time setting, specialize Gabow-Sankowski's integral-weight f-factor construction to f(v)=1, so f(V)=n. Its weighted blossom reconstruction supplies edges rather than just determinant weight, in randomized soft-O(W n^omega). This covers the intended bounded-integral algebraic setting; unrestricted real-weight machine models are not claimed covered by that bound.

The input permits arbitrary nonnegative weights and directed graphs. A random ordering gives half the total weight, not a strictly better worst-case approximation to optimum. Improving the ratio requires a global ordering argument; acyclic special inputs do not supply it.

The state space comprises all triangulations of arbitrary planar point sets. Connectivity of the flip graph does not bound conductance, stationary measure or mixing. Also choosing among flippable edges yields degree-biased stationarity unless corrected; no uniform mixing proof follows.

Strict comparison concerns analytic spectral-density exponents for all finite-volume hyperbolic interiors. L2-Betti vanishing does not control the near-zero spectral tail or cusp contributions, so no deduction of strict Novikov-Shubin bounds is available.
A periodic tetrahedron packing supplies a density lower bound only. Full densest packing requires an upper bound over all periodic and aperiodic packings; a small exact unit cell has no such bridge.

Primary report requires the exact full rigid-body flow, including attitude on SO(3), not only Jacobi functions for body momentum. An apparently direct 2008 successor was located, but its institutional PDF request returned 403; no alternate route attempted and no proof-body retirement claimed.

Primary context is optimization over particle trajectories for generalized Euler equations. Symplectic adjoint consistency can explain some gradients, but a direct link to optimization behavior requires an objective, discretization and convergence/stability theorem; a single conserved symplectic form is insufficient.

An h-principle compares the whole framed-function space to formal data on each closed smooth manifold. A local framed Morse chart does not give the required parametric relative extension or global homotopy equivalence.

All d>1 environments and both almost-sure quenched and annealed limit theorems are requested. Regeneration arguments need ellipticity, stationarity and moment hypotheses; these cannot be assumed universally and no classification covering degenerate regimes is supplied.

A massless three-dimensional phi-four construction needs a nontrivial continuum probability field with controlled ultraviolet and infrared limits. A finite lattice integral is finite but is not a tight renormalized continuum construction.

The scope includes ODEs, DAEs and PDAEs with computational tractability and tight convergence. Occupation measures/SOS require compactness, polynomial data, no relaxation gap and degree convergence; these hypotheses do not cover this unrestricted formulation.

All k>=4 and all n are quantified. The Frame-Stewart recurrence constructs legal transfers and gives upper bounds; proving no unrestricted strategy is faster for every peg count is the obstacle. Exact search at finitely many n cannot bridge it.

The first Steel-array index depends on the report's iteration I and coherent-realization definition. These are missing in the literal statement, so neither an index nor a failure witness can be verified from the record alone.

The demonstrative 'this technique' and Theorem 5 must be recovered before checking the forcing construction. A model without special trees obtained by unrelated forcing would not answer whether the designated technique proves the result.

For every odd d=2a+1>=3 take all a(a+1) cross-commutators between disjoint generator sets of sizes a,a+1. The enveloping algebra is the tensor product of two free associative algebras, with Hilbert series 1/(1-dt+a(a+1)t^2). The primary strong-freeness criterion then exceeds the printed a^2 bound. This is a routine bipartite construction, also within the successor's Proposition 5 criterion; no discovery from a likely printed-bound issue.

The kernel is a closed pro-2 group over the entire infinite splitting tower. Computing finitely many iterated Galois groups does not determine its order or index. Translation y=x+1 gives y^2-1, not y^2-2, so a cyclotomic Chebyshev shortcut is invalid.

The literal formulas contain corrupted coefficient objects and maps. Divisibility-minimal denominators require the precise integral Betti and de Rham lattices; clearing Fourier coefficient denominators alone would not compute both integral cohomology classes.

The existential target needs an explicit K not Q, tame S and proof of mildness, not just cohomological dimension 2. Primary report points to imaginary-quadratic work, while the inspected successor supplies general mildness criteria; no verified arithmetic presentation or local linking computation was performed.

The task classifies rationality for all genera and unspecified variants. Low-genus parametrizations do not handle general-type regimes or intermediate genera, and unirationality does not imply rationality.

All higher-genus orbit closures are quantified. A local affine-invariant-submanifold description would not alone prove algebraicity or resolve manifold versus immersed/orbifold language. No successor proof body was inspected for this target, so no public-resolution retirement is asserted.

The base field is arbitrary. Hochschild-Serre evaluation identifies an obstruction map from rational Picard classes to Br(k), but computing its image requires effective field and torsor data; this is not a uniform terminating algorithm for arbitrary k.

Existence of an invariant Sylow subgroup under the stated automorphism-order hypothesis must become a constructive algorithm for every exceptional Lie type. Enumerating a finite group gives a brute-force search only after existence and an input model; no short uniform structural construction was proved.

The relation module Lambda and available exact input/error bounds are not defined in the record. Decimal approximations alone cannot certify exact root relations without separation or algebraic height bounds; integer-relation guesses are not a certificate.

The input symbol is corrupted and g(X) is source-defined. An algebraic hull calculation needs the exact matrix and rational Jordan/eigenvalue data; no invariant meaning or full algorithm can be certified from the literal text alone.

Finite generation is promised for arbitrary algebraic G and affine X. Enumeration of invariants gives no termination certificate that the current list generates the ring; reductive invariant algorithms cannot silently supply the missing hypothesis.

Removing BV covers singular eikonal limits beyond rectifiable jump sets. BV recovery sequences and jump-energy lower bounds do not extend automatically to gradients without bounded variation; all admissible limits require compactness and matching liminf/limsup.

All ordered finite families of maximal tori and all simple Lie groups are allowed. Differential surjectivity gives only a local open subset of the product image; dimensions or Lie-algebra spanning alone do not characterize its exact global image.

An arbitrary lattice and some symplectic manifold are allowed, followed by dynamical interest and a closed-surface case. Cotangent lifting gives symplectomorphisms but not automatically Hamiltonian ones. No faithful Hamiltonian construction satisfying the intended manifold/support conditions was verified.

The renewal law, disorder assumptions and normalization of the transition order are on the preceding source page, with alpha/beta also corrupted in the record. A smoothing inequality would be a bound, not the exact small-disorder transition order across the stated regimes.

A terminating yes/no procedure on every resolution graph needs both an effective realization test and an effective nonrealizability certificate. Numerical intersection and plumbing constraints are necessary but do not characterize isolated hypersurface realizability.

All dimensions n and all minimizing cusped orbifolds are quantified. A lattice covolume construction gives upper bounds only; arithmetic volume formulas do not exclude nonarithmetic competitors or classify equality universally.

A universal O(n log n) edge upper bound is requested for every properly colored graph without rainbow cycles. A colored hypercube gives a lower-bound example only. No corresponding modern extremal proof body was inspected; no resolution claim based on memory/search labels.

All fixed k and every c in [1/k,1/2) are included. Absorption above an existence threshold does not decide divisibility barriers at this entire range; k=2 or c>1/2 does not settle the assignment. No full successor complexity proof was checked.

A single universal component threshold needs both a coloring construction for all subcubic graphs and examples forbidding the preceding threshold. A small graph lower bound or bounded exhaustive search cannot supply the all-order upper bound; successor proof not inspected.

A sudden complexity jump requires both a uniform coloring theorem above a critical C and reductions proving hardness below it for all degree-4 inputs. Symmetric relaxed coloring is not reduced to the asymmetric threshold by a trivial swap of color classes.
